entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Capital of the kingdom of Yotia on Dominaria, a prosperous city on the Mardun River sacked during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The kingdom whose capital was Kroog.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Kroog is located.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza whose forces brought about the collapse of Yotia.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra who gifted Kroog's healers amulets and declared war on his brother.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Warlord of Kroog
entities.description: Ruler of Kroog killed by the Qadir at the Peace Summit at Korlinda.

entities.name: Qadir of the Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Ruler of the Fallaji Empire who killed the Warlord of Kroog.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Inheritor of the title Queen of Kroog who refused to be called Warlady.

entities.name: Traxos
entities.description: Leader of Mishra's dragon engines at the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: The sack of Kroog by Mishra's dragon engines in a single morning in 28 AR.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The blast at the end of the war that caused the Mardun to flood most of Kroog.

entities.name: Fask
entities.description: Warlord who took Kroog by force and ruled until around 85 AR.

entities.name: Meria
entities.description: Leader of the largest group of elvish Yavimayan exiles living in Kroog's ruins.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Island on which the ruins of Kroog can be found.

events.summary: Urza gifts Kroog's healers potent amulets, and thousands flock to the city seeking healing.
events.quote: After joining the city, Urza gifted its healers potent amulets.

events.summary: The Warlord of Kroog is killed by the Qadir at the Peace Summit at Korlinda and Kayla bin-Kroog becomes Queen of Kroog.
events.quote: Kayla bin-Kroog inherited the title Queen of Kroog

events.summary: A second peace summit in Kroog fractures relations between the brothers and Urza declares war on Mishra.
events.quote: Urza declared war on his brother.

events.summary: Kroog is sacked by Mishra's dragon engines led by Traxos in a single morning in 28 AR.
events.quote: when the city was sacked by Mishra's dragon engines

events.summary: The Sylex Blast causes the Mardun to flood most of Kroog.
events.quote: the Sylex Blast caused the Mardun to flood most of the city

events.summary: The warlord Fask claims Kroog's seat by force; his soldiers abandon him around 85 AR and his realm is carved up.

relations.quote: Kroog was the capital of the kingdom of Yotia

relations.note: at the Peace Summit at Korlinda
relations.quote: the Warlord was killed by the Qadir of the Fallaji Empire

relations.note: Urza declared war on his brother
relations.quote: Urza declared war on his brother.
relations between the brothers quickly fractured completely
